text: Doctor Prasit is always helpful and extremely knowledgeable. We have been using him as our main doctor  for any of our Muay Thai students from our gym.  He has treated be invaluable on so mnay occasions for injured fighters

Excellent little clinic!  Great English spoken here if that’s a concern. They are very kind and very efficient.

Extremely affordable care for all your small clinic needs. I will definitely return for further (small) needs, instead of driving all the way to the hospital.

The doctor here is very knowledgeable and friendly. My husband had water in his ear that caused an infection, and the doctor prescribed ear drops that were very effective. Our cost was 500 baht, which is very reasonable. The doctor also issued a formal prescription, which is convenient for insurance claims. There is parking available right in front, making it very convenient.

They speak English and it was really easy to make an appointment over the phone. I needed follow up rabies shot, the whole procedure lasted 2 min and 700 baht instead of the 2 h 1500 baht it took me in another hospital. I highly recommend this clinic ✨✨

I can't recommend Dr. Prasit highly enough. He treated a staph infection I had with excellent care, was always very available and responsive, and his rates are very reasonable compared to other doctors.
Dr. Prasit is the best. He’s been our family physician for 7 years and is a kind professional Doctor who has always helped us a lot. Thanks Dr. Prasit ❤️

I had a very positive experience during my recent visit to Dr. Prasit. He was extremely gentle, polite, and attentive, ensuring I received the necessary medication. Dr. Prasit was very kind, always smiling, and took the time to explain each step of the treatment process thoroughly.

Thank you, Dr. Prasit, for your excellent care. I am already feeling much better.

The cost of the visit was reasonable at 1,400 Baht, which included two injections and four packs of medication.

Highly recommended Doctor!   His kind demeanor, communication and thorough examination were excellent. I had a lingering post viral inflammation for weeks and after beginning the medications prescribed by Dr Prasit was feeling much better by the next day.  Would not hesitate to return.

Great little clinic. So glad I found them. Needed a daily wound cleaning and dressing change and at other private clinics, I was paying between 1300B to 1700B and more at the private hospital. Even the public hospital and clinics charged around 600B. This clinic was only 200B. And the nurse is very knowledgeable about my condition because she sees it every day.  I didn’t interact with the doctor but based on the nurse, I’d highly recommend this little clinic.

Doctor prasit and his team of staff are the only place you should seek to visit if you are having any problems. Dr Prasit is extremely knowledgeable, very straight forward and has done more for me in just 2 visits to his clinic than anyone has done in 25 years of seeing a variety of different doctors across Australia. I reckon he could figure out a fix for just about anything and is also great to talk to about any general life problems aswell. Couldn't possibly reccomend these guys anymore. Literally changed my life for the better.

Doctor Prasit absolutely the best clinic and the most passionate and professional doctor I have ever met on this island. I have been on this island for over 15years and never had such a professional doctor, not even en Europe. Highly recommended and will always be my first choice!

First let me say I did not have any treatment with the doctor. I walked and showed him a bump I thought might need quick surgery. The point of this review is the character of the doctor. Incredible, honest, easy to talk to and smart. He would be my first stop again. Thank you to the staff for making me feel so at ease in a distant country.

Dr Prasit is so kind. We were scratched by a monkey and wasn’t sure if we should get a rabies vaccine. He talked us through the whole process. Decided to better be safe than sorry. He made us feel so welcome and safe. Even stayed a little after clinic closed. Thank you Dr. Prasit!

Doctor Prasit is very friendly, and he is such a great doctor. My husband had some cuts on his both feet and 2 of them got infected. We went there 3 times, Doctor Prasit did a brilliant job. Highly recommend him if you have medical problems during your holiday in Phuket.

Walked in for a UTI that progressed rapidly. Was seen immediately by the doctor, whose English was very good. We discussed symptoms and treatment options, as well as a follow up. As a nurse, I was very pleased with the thoroughness and speed with which everything was executed. Total for visit, urine sample, and antibiotic was 800baht. Would highly recommend. Remember to bring passport.

I came in to clean my ears. Took about 90min because 60min of that was waiting for the hydrogen peroxide to infiltrate the wax and 30min of actual flushing.

Cost was 800 baht which is considerably cheaper than other places that charge 2000 baht plus and this would normally cost me $150 USD (5000 baht equivalent) back home.

Dr. Prasit speaks English, Chinese, and Thai.

Excellent service and price.

text: I had a metatarsal fracture. I was in Bangkok Hospital in Phuket. But the German health insurance company wanted sick leave. with date. So I went to Dr. Prasit. He wrote everything down again, how long it takes to heal. Thanks very much. The health insurance company was satisfied and accepted it that way. Thank you very much.
Very nice people, very efficient and without the blablabla. This is how it should be done. Thank you!

I got bitten by a dog on the beach. Granted it was very minor however I was worried about getting rabies and the vaccine asap. Thankfully,this clinic which is super close to Bang Tao beach where I was staying, took me straight in and gave me a shot on the spot. They were super quick, friendly and efficient and I felt well cared for. Can't recommend them highly enough!

Super professional doctor with the PERFECT English. He will not distinguish by farang/thai. He will do his job. The most interesting - he called me the next day and asked how I feel? Literally shocked. Doctor visit, 3 different type of pills(more than 15 in each) 640 thai baht for everything. In bang tao area. Unbelievable! Thank you so much 🙏🏽
Dr Prasit is extremely helpful and quick. He speaks English and Chinese fluently too. And he does not charge the crazy prices of the private hospitals when one is down with minor issues. 🙏 …

Great service, friendly staff, and knowledgeable doctor.

Caught some food bug whilst on holiday. At Prasit I was assessed and out the door with medicine within 10 minutes.

I got staph training MMA down here in Bangtao. Everyone spoke english and was able to help me through the situation (First time getting it. I had to get the staph cut out and have anti biotics provided to me. The pricing was better than fair and I was even given treats everyday when I had my wound cleaned.

Dr.Prasit was very professional and helpful,  except proper medication provided,  i was also lent with the clinics ice pack which helped me ease the pain during night. I am very grateful for their service, Thank You!

Dr Prasit from Prasit clinic Cherngtalay is one of the best Doctors in Phuket. He is articulate and caring and kind. He has done house visits to a friend of mine, as he has Parkinsons. Also a good friend.
I was there for several simple wound cleanings.  Quick attention, from nurse, seemed knowledgeable, good English, and inexpensive.  One third the cost of Laguna Wellness, both good...

Dr Prasit Koysiripong recently opened his new clinic "Prasit Clinic" in Choeng Talay, Bangtao, Phuket. Its located opposite Baan Bangtao Clinic.  Dr Prasit is an excellent Doctor, professional, very personable, caring & helpful & speaks very good English.
Dr Prasit is a fantastic doctor, excellent manners and speaks perfect English. We trust his opinion and would highly recommend him if you need a doctor.
I had to visit Dr Prasit a couple of times for my skin condition. He’s very patient, professional and didn’t charge a lot. He can speak Thai, English and Chinese.
Very professional and kind people working at the clinic
Amazing service, doctor knew straight away what my illness was and fixed me up within 2 days. Amazing service, can speak English well too
Very good doctor and excellent clinic
Very nice and intelligent doctor. Can help you or at least give useful advice on any health matter. Highly recommended.
Dr Prasit is an excellent Doctor in Phuket.  Highly recommend him if you are looking for a good Doctor.

Very good doctor,  very experienced. Good English spoken by doctor and staff.
very good price for turists.
Great doctor, great English, really helpful, way better than phuket hospitals
The doctor speaks fluent English which is rare here. The prices are quite low.
Staff and doctor Very kind and fast
Very good service, reliable and reasonable price.
the best Doctor very friendly and kind.
Dr. Prasit is very nice and kind
Professional and courteous staff.
Very genuine staff

I came in the morning to get a staph infection looked at. I was quickly looked after, in and out in less than an hour. The doctor and nurse were very kind, friendly and spoke English very well. I highly recommend this place.

I received treatment at this dermatology clinic and was very impressed. The doctor gave excellent advice, explained everything in detail, and was easy to understand. They also followed up on my treatment progress continuously. …

The doctor was very polite and kind, with good medical ethics. He didn't prolong the treatment and explained the details until I understood. The staff at the counter were very smiling and attentive to details. They provided detailed information about the prescribed medication. The price was reasonable. I highly recommend this place.

We were here with our children, who had bronchitis. We received a very warm welcome, and the doctor was very competent and spoke good English. It was clear that this wasn't just about money; health was the priority. The medication helped us. We are very grateful and highly recommend this clinic.
The doctor is very kind and the service is excellent. I highly recommend this place.

An excellent doctor, a true professional. He diagnosed me with sinusitis and prescribed treatment that helped. The examination, injection, and medication cost 960 baht, which is relatively cheap. I called the next day to check on how I was feeling. Thank you!
Dr. Prasit is a very lovely person and the price is not expensive. I recommend him.
